correctness.domain_rule: D_search and D_cert use disjoint explicitly named cases
correctness.comparison_rule: every edge is direct; tolerance transitivity is forbidden

candidate_space.search_object: concrete post-pass MLIR state plus schedule assignment and transformation trace
candidate_space.failed_attempt_rule: one distinct exact candidate that fails before state formation consumes one budget unit
candidate_space.expanded_arm_nesting_rule: bounded-search and anytime diagnostics visit the fixed-structure schedule spine in the same C-conditioned order before visiting other concrete lowering states; this order does not truncate the complete-space main performance envelope
candidate_space.c_fixed_rule: the canonical structural path plus one mechanical legal projection of the authored C tile/schedule forms exactly one candidate and performs no search, workload-derived occupancy and cost heuristics are forbidden
candidate_space.abstraction_rule: no implementation-family object, family id, or named emitter participates in generation, legality, or selection

measurement.external_match_rule: operator, shape, dtype, layout, output relation, timed boundary, cache policy, device and profiler must match exactly
measurement.timed_scope: prepared launch or prepared graph only; allocation and correctness synchronization are outside the timed closure
measurement.finalist_rule: fresh round-robin remeasurement with alternating traversal; initial ranking samples are excluded
measurement.confirmation_rule: equal-count fresh matched-baseline and target batches in alternating pair order
measurement.warmup_rule: before confirmation, Source and target prepared thunks receive the same declared untimed time budget in round-robin order; cold-data timing then evicts L2 before every measured launch
measurement.e3_e2_comparison_rule: the primary marginal E3/E2 gain selects the complete fixed-structure schedule-spine best and complete global best from one transported candidate universe and one target timing run; separately launched bounded E2/E3 searches remain anytime diagnostics
measurement.main_three_arm_rule: C-Fixed, Schedule-Only and IntentIR are performance envelopes over one mechanical C projection, the complete canonical-path schedule space and the complete admitted lowering-state space respectively; Source remains the mandatory independent GPU external baseline
measurement.aggregation: median per side with every paired batch retained

budget_rule: C-Fixed receives exactly one mechanical legal projection of C; the caller-supplied equal budget governs bounded C-guided and Erase-C search-efficiency orders, while formal Schedule-Only and IntentIR performance envelopes use the complete admitted candidate space
